breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous instruction to set end slopes to zero under symmetric loading. It does not include any statement about zero slopes at the supports, matching the ground truth which simply asks for the slope at x=0 without imposing an incorrect zero-slope boundary condition. The generated text correctly treats the beam as a standard simply supported beam where support rotations are free to occur.
